question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**cemetery**.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage is about examining a gravestone, which is typically found in a cemetery.
 
• A **cemetery **(कब्रिस्तान) is the appropriate setting for gravestones.
 
• The word '**cemetery**' directly relates to the theme of graves and gravestones.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Sentence: "*As a boy, I was always exploring lonely places—neglected gardens and orchards, unoccupied houses, patches of scrub or wasteland, the fields outside the town, the fringes of the forest. On one of my rambles **behind__* *the bungalow, I pushed my way through a thicket of lantana bushes and stumbled over a thick stone slab, twisting my ankle slightly as I fell. For some time, I sat on the grass massaging my foot. When the pain eased, I looked more **__closely__ at the stone slab and was surprised to find that it was a gravestone. It was almost entirely covered by ivy; obviously no one had been near it for years. I tugged at the ivy and some of it came away in my hands. There was some *__*blurred*__* lettering on the grave, half-obscured by grass and moss. I could make out a name—Rose—but little more. I sat there for some time, **__pondering__ over my discovery. I was wondering why ‘Rose’ should have been buried at so lonely a spot when there was a *__*cemetery*__* not far away.*"

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **dormitory **(छात्रावास): This refers to a large bedroom for multiple people, typically students, and is not relevant to the context.
 
• **kennel **(कुत्ते का घर): This refers to a shelter for dogs, which is not appropriate here.
 
• **sanctuary **(आश्रय स्थल): This typically refers to a place of refuge or safety, which does not fit the context of gravestones and burial.
